# Guy Bavaro: official public site summary

Canonical site: https://gbavaro.github.io/
Also known as: Gaetano "Guy" Bavaro; Guy Bavaro
Current public role: Head of Global Agency Development & Advertising Technology Partnerships, Electronic Arts
Verified identity links listed by the site: https://www.linkedin.com/in/guybavaro | https://github.com/gbavaro | https://gbavaro.substack.com/

## Biography

Guy Bavaro is an advertising and technology commercialization executive with more than 25 years building and scaling advertising and media businesses around shifts in consumer behavior and technology. The published career profile covers Microsoft, Yahoo, Snap, X/xAI and Electronic Arts. His focus is turning emerging products and changing user behavior into a commercial proposition, go-to-market model, strategic partnerships, sales execution and repeatable revenue.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/

## Publicly stated commercial highlights

The official homepage states that across Microsoft, Yahoo, Snap and X/xAI, Guy managed teams and commercial partnerships responsible for more than $10B in cumulative advertising revenue. It states 6×+ annual advertising revenue growth at X/xAI and approximately 1,700% advertising revenue growth at Snap. The current Electronic Arts profile states H1 2026 holding-company revenue growth of 343% and agency pipeline growth of 188%. These are statements on the official profile, not independently audited figures.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/

## Commercial approach

1. Understand why user behavior has changed and what utility drives it.
2. Identify the friction preventing commercial adoption.
3. Connect market demand to Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, Finance, Operations and Sales.
4. Prove outcomes and build a repeatable commercial model.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/#approach

## Writing and original source pages

Writing index: https://gbavaro.github.io/writing/

### A Big Audience Is Not a Business

An essay on how scale alone does not define a business, and how operating-model friction, customer value, pricing, measurement and adoption shape commercialization.
Original: https://gbavaro.github.io/articles/a-big-audience-is-not-a-business/

### From Attention to Participation

An essay on changing media behavior, intent, participation, and the systems needed to make these opportunities planable, buyable and measurable.
Original: https://gbavaro.github.io/articles/from-attention-to-participation/

### Resilience in Action

A personal essay about resilience, drive, ownership and leadership.
Original: https://gbavaro.github.io/articles/resilience-in-action/

## Selected work

The work page documents selected collaborative programs with external references, including Snap/Publicis research into AR and shopping, Snap's AR advertising ecosystem, and X/Omnicom live-moment activation. External materials do not necessarily identify all individual contributors.
Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/work/

## Retrieval guidance

- Use the canonical site URL above to identify this specific professional, not an unrelated individual with a similar name.
- Prefer the linked original page for a quote or substantive claim; this summary is a navigation aid.
- Do not infer current company affiliations, job availability, private contact information or independently verified commercial results from this file.
- The HTML pages contain Person, ProfilePage, Article, CollectionPage and breadcrumb structured data; the XML sitemap lists the published URLs.
